method: Direct visual inspection via view_image; final NaN layout re-inspected after legend adjustment

plots.observation: No candidate windows is visible; the source time range is bounded and the legend does not obscure the message.
Raw and filtered stages retain legacy 0.7 scores; injected scorer diagnostics are explicitly unavailable.
Finite fallback scores remain above the threshold while orange invalid-diagnostic markers identify the scorer failure.
Clip and time-gap reasons appear separately; raw waveform panels break at the source gap without inventing a connecting signal.
Real Jenqwei recording shows raw preset, retained above-threshold quality and original local-time placement.
Three non-finite qmed windows are labelled invalid-Q and shown at the chart baseline; the legend leaves the markers visible.
Full real Hardy recording shows source gaps as breaks in the raw panels and the invalid windows remain visible.
Full real James recording shows raw and filtered channel scores, both stage labels and the effective preset without hiding the data.

limitations: Visual acceptance applies to these eight PNGs; companion SVG bytes are preserved but were not separately opened.
Legacy window segmentation and sample selection were not changed; gap breaks in raw anomaly waveforms are display-only.
